_note: Zero-quota plumbing config: the ONLY upstream is the local mock LLM (scripts/mock-llm.mjs, :8899). Deliberately omits `model` — an upstream without a model field is a WILDCARD in the router's model filter (llm-router.mjs candidates()), which is what lets it answer a request for any model name. In llm-router.config.json every real upstream declares its model, so a mock can never silently answer a production request. Use this to verify wiring (dsh → router → MCP → NLP → ERPNext) without spending provider quota.
